stories.title: CISA Adds Three Known Exploited Vulnerabilities to Catalog
stories.summary: CISA has added three new vulnerabilities to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) Catalog , based on evidence of active exploitation.
stories.why_it_matters: Defenders should treat this as an immediate exposure-management priority, confirm whether affected systems are internet-facing, review available indicators, and apply verified vendor mitigations or updates.

stories.title: Unpatched Cacti zero-day with public PoC gives remote code execution
stories.summary: A zero-day vulnerability in the Cacti network monitoring platform has been publicly disclosed, along with a proof-of-concept exploit that lets unauthenticated attackers execute commands on vulnerable servers.
stories.why_it_matters: Security teams should review the original reporting, determine whether the development affects their environment, and adjust monitoring or controls when supported by verified details.

stories.title: Switzerland Confirms AI-Assisted Cyberattacks Breached Critical Infrastructure Operators
stories.summary: Attackers using AI agents have broken into computer systems at Swiss organizations in four of five confirmed attacks, the first such cases in the country, the country's cybersecurity agency said yesterday.
stories.why_it_matters: Security and technology teams should assess the development for changes to model risk, data handling, access controls, and their existing AI governance.
